statusScope: FIRST review of exactly six bound saved PNGs, supported by the supplied two-view DOM evidence. No blocking visibility/layout/label/math/clipping/end-content defect observed. One nonblocking duplicated-breadcrumb observation is retained. This is not original-source fidelity, headed acceptance, every-glyph certification or complete English accessibility approval.
reviewer: D1317 independent reviewer of the separately assigned FIRST saved-pixel batch

scope.views: Each viewport has one whole-course image, one saved initial viewport and one Figure 22 element screenshot.

viewAssessments.wholeCourse: The title, successive text/formula groups, two footnotes, Figure 22, separate retained Figure 22 caption and final ratio-condition paragraph are visible. The centered column has ample side margins; no gross clipping, overlap, empty media or prematurely missing tail is visible.
viewAssessments.savedViewport: The opening prose and footnote render clearly with stable line spacing. The repaired extrapolation definition and complete real-gas cooling sentence are visible. The bottom viewport edge cuts an ongoing later paragraph because the page continues; the whole-course image and DOM distinguish this normal viewport boundary from missing document content.
viewAssessments.figure: The Kelvin/Celsius headers, all three paired numerical levels, units, minus sign, outlined scales, short ticks, bottom dashed reference and Integer approximation note are visibly legible and separated. No label is cut by the figure frame.
viewAssessments.caption: Figure 22 is present as the separate caption in the whole-course view, in the retained source-object order after the intervening derivation. It is not inside the supplied Figure 22 element screenshot; its absence from that element image is not a missing course caption.
viewAssessments.math: The displayed conversion, coefficient derivation, volume formula and volume/temperature ratio occupy distinct lines with retained equation labels. No gross overlap or missing formula block is visible. Fine denominator/subscript certification is outside the tall-overview scope.

endContent.assessment: The last Kelvin-denominator/Celsius-substitution paragraph appears above the bottom whitespace, consistent with the supplied DOM box.

viewAssessments.wholeCourse: The title, single-column text, footnotes, later formulas, Figure 22, retained numbered caption and final paragraph remain visible within the column. No gross horizontal truncation, overlapping prose or lost end content is visible.
viewAssessments.savedViewport: The heading and early prose/footnote have readable wrapping and line spacing at the supplied 390px viewport. The breadcrumb wraps without covering the title or first paragraph. The footnote continues beyond the saved initial viewport, as shown by the whole-course image and DOM.
viewAssessments.figure: At the actual 358px media width, Kelvin/Celsius and all numerical labels remain readable. The bottom 0 K/-273 degrees Celsius labels, dashed reference and Integer approximation note are fully visible. K has no degree mark, and the Celsius degree marks and negative sign are visible. No collision with the image edges or scale lines is observed.
viewAssessments.caption: The separate Figure 22 caption is visibly retained in the full-course image at its original object position. Its small caption text is not a reason to claim that every fine prose glyph has been certified.
viewAssessments.math: The conversion, coefficient derivation, volume formula, ratio and equation labels visibly remain inside the mobile column. The whole preview is resampled, so this supports placement and lack of gross clipping, not every small mathematical glyph.

endContent.assessment: The final warning against substituting Celsius numerical values is visible above the bottom margin, consistent with the DOM tail.

currentFigureLabelAssessment.recordedActualPlatformFonts: Arial-BoldMT for the eight headers/numerical labels and ArialMT for the approximation note.
currentFigureLabelAssessment.loadedUsedMathFaces: The supplied DOM records loaded KaTeX_Main, KaTeX_Math and KaTeX_Size1 faces. Other listed faces are unused/unloaded; this is not a claim that every font face or every document glyph was independently verified.

genuineFindings.title: Chapter breadcrumb is repeated
genuineFindings.observation: Both saved headings repeat 'Chapter 2. Fundamentals of thermodynamics' twice before Printed page 31. The supplied DOM crumb reports the same repeated string.
genuineFindings.impact: Redundant breadcrumb text makes the hierarchy less clear and adds a line on mobile, but remains contained and does not obscure the title, lesson content, math, caption or end content.
genuineFindings.disposition: Nonblocking for this bounded visibility/layout review. Record for the parent to consider as a separate metadata concern; no source identity, lesson text or breadcrumb code was changed here.

limits.tallPreview: Whole-course images establish broad placement and tail visibility, not reliable inspection of every tiny letter, denominator or subscript. The mobile whole image was explicitly resized by the tool from 390x6446 to 363x6000.
limits.fineGlyphs: Only the supplied ordinary viewport prose and nine figure labels have the stated close-view observations. No crops, magnified reopens or further equation-detail screenshots were made. No all-glyph or all-prose raster/font certification is claimed.
limits.savedViewportCoverage: The files called polarization-viewport are reused helper filenames. Their actual pixels show this Absolute temperature lesson's initial viewport. They do not prove that all later definitions were viewed at full viewport scale.
limits.headless: D1319 records isolated-headless offline native HTML, headed=false and headedAcceptanceClaimed=false. Saved pixels do not certify the production site, interactive scrolling behavior, a real-device session, headed acceptance or browser states outside these captures.
limits.sourceAndARIA: D1318 explicitly retains source Chinese machine labels and section identity. D1319 records Figure 22 as the inspected figure's generic English ariaLabel and does not report retained Chinese ARIA labels for this view. That does not establish full English localization of every source-derived attribute, a descriptive alternative for the scale comparison, screen-reader comprehension or accessibility of the whole course.
limits.originalSourceScienceAndFigureApproval: Existing original-source, scientific, registered-erratum and unchanged-figure approvals are preserved. These saved PNGs are not a reason to replay them or to invent historical whole-English approval.
